changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/abbreviated dataset names, normalized model names to consistent capitalization, removed output descriptions that were actually evaluation metrics, and added missing models mentioned in comparisons. Added clearer output descriptions.
Normalized metric names to consistent capitalization and removed duplicate entries. Bits-Per-Character (BPC) is the standard term for character-level language modeling evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this 2020 paper. The paper only uses traditional automatic metrics like perplexity, BPC, and BLEU.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on architectural improvements to transformer models through sublayer reordering, with evaluations primarily on language modeling tasks using automatic metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of names and removal of some redundant/incorrect items. The paper does not conduct human or LLM-as-judge evaluations.
